regime_context: China A-shares thematic tape is a narrow, one-narrative structure: Coal (515220.SS) is the only theme that is both eligible and high-durability, while Banks are eligible and crowded but trending; the rotation read itself is display-only. Critically, the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (mean-reverting tape), gate_helps is false, and the trader's own track record shows dir_accuracy of 0.337 — so conviction must be very low and the note is deliberately small.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Coal's one-narrative dominance persists into a confirmed handoff toward Banks or SOE Blue Chips (both trending, both crowded). If Banks (512800.SS) closes above Coal (515220.SS) on a rolling 10-day total-return basis for five consecutive sessions, the one-narrative structure would be retired and a Financials/Value leadership read becomes the base case.

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the dominant eligible leader with a 0.52 durability bar, headline weight 0.25, and the only non-trivial 10-day return among eligible themes (r10 0.0114), but its Hurst tag is mean-revert and breadth is only 0.5 with one_narrative true. In a market whose validated discipline (trend gate) failed historically, chasing a mean-reverting leader with weak breadth offers no accountable edge. A neutral-to-avoid stance reflects humility, not a fade call.
evidence: rank 1, score 0.992, eligible true (attention/focus lens only)
theses.dissent: Coal is the cleanest eligible expression of the dominant narrative and the only theme with both eligibility and a positive 10-day tail; in a momentum continuation regime it could outperform the CSI 300 despite weak breadth.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS underperforms CSI 300 by more than 3% over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are eligible and trending (Hurst trend, durability_bar 0.83, breadth 1.0), but they are crowded (crowding_z 1.83, crowded true) with crowding texture the guardrails explicitly say not to act on except as a down-size caution. With the trend gate unvalidated on this market and tracker dir_accuracy at 0.337, the disciplined read is to stay out rather than chase a crowded financials theme.
evidence: guardrails: crowding is SIZE-DOWN only, never a buy trigger
theses.dissent: Banks are the strongest trend-health theme in the table and have the fullest breadth; a value-rotation into SOE blue chips could keep them outperforming even into crowding.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags CSI 300 by more than 3% over the next 15 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
